purpose: Diagnostic of prediction execution granularity after the same scene can be fit more closely offline. It changes no weights and is separate from the frozen five-control comparison.
coupled_effect: The same seeded noise stream is consumed more frequently because there are more policy calls; the test does not isolate feedback frequency from noise-consumption frequency.
reporting_limit: This diagnostic profile cannot be mixed with five-control baseline, SFT or PPO rates. A chosen profile would require all stages to be evaluated again with identical controls. No generalization or improvement is assumed.
